citation: Porter, Simon (2021). Shape Model of Nix. figshare. Version 1. CC BY 4.0.
scaleQualification: STL has no intrinsic length unit. The raw coordinate extents are 96.82894 × 67.65795 × 62.99126; multiplying by 0.5 km matches the release description dimensions 48.4 × 33.8 × 31.4 km within rounding/model-description differences. This scale is an explicit inference from the paired mesh and source description, not a kilometre unit declared inside STL.
coordinateSystem: Released model XYZ retained without rotation, recentering or invented topography. Spherical map longitude = atan2(y,x), north latitude = asin(z/r).
orientationQualification: Released mesh omits fitted pole/prime-meridian/image-registration files. Historical encounter pole and arbitrary display phase do not establish absolute mesh attitude.

material.qualification: All source texels unavailable; entirely marked no-data before shared gray-grid preparation.

coverage: Broad shape constrained by LORRI southern/equatorial images and MVIC northern extent. This parametric fit is not a global measured elevation map.
